title: Software Design - Project Engineer & Long Term Intern
desc:
Step into the future of fintech with us!
We’re not just a company; we’re a dynamic team of innovators pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We're on the lookout for passionate, forward-thinking
Software Design – Project Engineer & Long Term Intern
to join us on this exciting journey
Software Design – Project Engineer & Long Term Intern
works cross-functionally to help businesses start using Token products as and quickly as possible.
🔍Who We Are
At Token Financial Technologies, we lead Turkey’s fintech revolution, empowering over 800,000 users and handling nearly 4 million transactions daily. Our flagship solutions, Ödero and TokenFlex, redefine payment systems and corporate benefits with cutting-edge technology. As part of Koç Holding and partnering with Beko, we’re a team of innovators dedicated to driving progress and making a real impact in the financial world.
✨ What You’ll Be Rocking
Support application development processes for Linux and/or Android–based devices
(using C/C++, Java, or Kotlin).
Contribute to the development and testing of POS devices, EMV applications, and payment system components.
Assist the team in integration, testing, certification, and deployment phases of banking applications and payment infrastructures.
Provide technical support to 3rd-party developers regarding SDKs, APIs, and payment modules.
Actively participate in log analysis, issue detection, and troubleshooting processes.
Create technical documentation and manage communication with the developer ecosystem.
Follow project plans, track tasks, and coordinate effectively with the technical team.
Take part in the development of secure payment processes.
🎯 The Perfect Fit
Computer Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering or other relevant engineering fields students (3rd or 4th year) or newly graduated candidates.
Strong interest in embedded systems, Linux/Android development, and payment technologies.
Experience in developing school, internship, or personal projects using at least one of the following: C/C++ or Java/Kotlin.
Basic knowledge of Linux or Android operating system architectures.
Fundamental understanding of software development processes (version control, testing, debugging).
Interest in network structures, encryption, secure data communication, or payment protocols (hands-on experience is a plus).
Willingness to learn about SDKs, APIs, and service integrations.
